units: Nidd. 13ᵇ כמין פ׳ של פרשים (Vers. in Ar. פלניא) like the feminalia of horsemen.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 84:16">Gen. R. s. 84</cite> (ref. to <he>אשר עליו</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 37:23">Gen. XXXVII, 23</cite>) <he>זו פ׳ שלו</he> this refers to his breeches; Yalk. ib. 142 <cite ref="Q01085"><he>פלמניא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 27:6">Kel. XXVII, 6</cite> <cite ref="Q01137"><he>פמוליניא</he></cite> (ed. Dehr. <cite ref="Q00718"><he>פימלנייה</he></cite>).
Gen. R. s. 99 אלו … לובשי פמלליא these (the priests) wear trousers, and those (the Greeks) wear feminalia.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 4">Num. R. s. 4</cite> <he>עטוף פעליונין</he> (read: <he>פִּמְלְיוֹנִין</he>) he was wrapped in feminalia.
